summary: OpenAI introduced new credit usage analytics and updated spend controls for ChatGPT Enterprise admins, including a unified Cost API and configurable per-group/per-user credit limits.

practices.reason: A new Cost API and admin-configurable spend limits give engineering teams a new integration point for tracking and controlling ChatGPT/Codex credit usage programmatically.
practices.quote: Access the same credit usage data through the unified Cost API for deeper analysis in their own systems
